name: Omega no Shikai -Aki Kaketa Shiki no Ai-
original_name: Omegaの視界 アキかけたシキのアイ
source:
Main character heads for the northern countryside in order to investigate the mysterious group. One by one group members come to the stage, and soon protagonist is put before a terrible and cruel choice...
